text:
Jordan: Hi all, joining today! Need a simple "who-to-ping" for first week ops: deploy problems, getting Private deploy creds, quick security questions.

Maya: welcome @Jordan!! quick map: deploy issues -> Eng Releases; Private creds -> Eng Infra + People Ops; security -> SecOps.

Ken: +1. Eng Releases handles CI/CD and rollout blockers. If it's a deploy hang, ping #eng-releases and the releases-oncall. For urgent rollbacks use `releases rollback <deploy-id>`.

Jordan: good to know, do we have emails or direct contacts?

Maya: short list to paste: `releases-oncall@pagerduty.com`, `infra-approvals@redwood.com`, `secops@redwood.com`. Also add your manager for access approvals.

oncall-bot: FYI: releases-oncall rotation for this week: Ken -> oncall ends 1991280000. See https://redwood-internal/oncall-schedule

Ken: For Private deploy creds file an infra ticket and link the service name + justification. Use the template: https://redwood-internal/sops/private-deploy-template.md. People Ops must approve for new hires.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: new hire access takes ~48-72 hours from ticket creation if manager approval provided. Use tag `newhire:yes` to expedite.

Jordan: who covers customer escalations and who to cc?

Maya: Customer escalations -> Customer Success (cs@redwood.com). For prod incidents include Eng SRE + CS. Escalation path: Pager -> Eng SRE -> SRE Lead -> Eng Platform.

Ken: Also add Security to the loop for data-related incidents. Slack channels: `#incidents` for public incident chatter, `#incident-private` for sensitive threads.

Jordan: Awesome — saved. Any quick tips for first-week priorities besides access?

Maya: 1) Get access tickets in day 1. 2) Join team onboarding syncs. 3) Read the runbooks in the wiki: https://redwood-internal/wiki/runbooks.

Jordan: perfect, thanks y'all :pray:
